propositions: Current deterministic clarity checks reward volume and heading presence without validating required section content, allowing padded tickets to pass without grounded Approach, Scope, or AC verification
Clarity score computation is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py with inconsistent bug handling, creating drift risk when extending criteria
Plan-writing guidance requires grounded sections (Context/Problem, Scope, Approach) and per-AC verification coverage, but deterministic checks do not enforce these structural requirements
Placeholder phrases (TBD, figure out, verify whether, depends on investigation) that defer decisions should be detectable and should penalize clarity, but are not currently checked deterministically
AC checkbox items lack mechanical verification that each is accompanied by concrete proving clauses or operator attestation, making coverage incomplete and unquantified

Author guide requests for rejected alternatives and Success Criteria conflict with authoritative criteria definitions (G6, epic 1386) and should not be encoded deterministically until conflicts are resolved
